selectionMethod.silence: Lowest two-second smoothed RMS after excluding the first and last fifteen seconds, used as a repeatable interior quiet-floor fixture
selectionMethod.sparse: Low non-silent RMS plus low normalized pitch activity and low positive flux
selectionMethod.build: Largest ten-second RMS and pitch-activity rise with an energetic endpoint
selectionMethod.drop: Largest three-second RMS and pitch-activity fall after an energetic frame
selectionMethod.dense: High stable RMS plus broad pitch activity and pitch-class entropy

segments.label: Quiet floor · 近静音

segments.label: Sparse · 稀疏
segments.listeningIntent: Test whether the underlying material keeps air, spacing, and fine structure when little energy is present

segments.label: Build · 堆叠
segments.listeningIntent: Test accumulated energy, continuity, and rising destruction without flattening the source identity

segments.label: Drop · 坠落

segments.label: Dense · 高密度
segments.listeningIntent: Stress the renderer at near-maximum real musical density and check whether both materials remain distinguishable
